title: Sleek and handsome, but heat dissiptation is a bit weak.
text:
Sleek and handsome, but heat dissiptation is a bit weak.. Maybe I'm just used to the space heaters that blow out heat to the point that it burns my skin if I'm too close, but this heater is a bit weak for my experience. It's not bad; we tried it in a medium-sized living room and it struggled to warm the room unless it was on the highest setting. Unsure whether that's intended, but it was unexpected.

Out of the box, it just needs either the wheels or the wall mount installed. We opted for the wheels since we'll be using this in different rooms. There's a small screen on the front with all the buttons you need: strength, child lock, temperature, and timer. The screen turns off after 3 minutes of non-activity; I prefer there be a feature that keeps it on since I like looking at the temperature. As for temperature, it goes by 5-temperature increments; for example, there's 70 and 75, but no way to make it 71-74. There are also a timer and child-lock features, so no worrying about leaving this on accidentally. There's a main power switch to the side that needs to be flipped before the heater can be used. The heater also comes with a remote that has all the same buttons.

It's definitely a nice-looking heater that's light, thin, and portable, but I wish the heat strength were stronger.
